items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I played in a club with Herb Ellis in Paris

ctx.x: So how was that affecting his playing?

It was affecting his attitude. Sitting around in the dressing room [I’d say] “What do you want to play?” [he’d say] “I don’t know what do you want to play?” He’d suggest a tune and I’d say okay and then when it came to the tune I couldn’t remember how it went and I’d say “you start.” That Herb Ellis tune “Detour Ahead”. Incidentally, I played in a club with Herb Ellis in Paris and we finished “Body and Soul” or whatever and I said “Do you know ‘Detour Ahead’?”
